name: Tibaná (Colombia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above and red below, with the inscription MUNICIPIO DE TIBANA in black and a green clover leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Tibaná, a municipality in the department of Boyacá, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: inscription MUNICIPIO DE TIBANA along the diagonal
